hooks.text: 三名队员可在同一回合连续释放多种技能，把资源规划转化为层层衔接的协同攻势。
hooks.excerpt: Each character has a rich and versatile skill set, letting you freely plan an entire turn around your resources and chain multiple abilities together. When your three party members link their actions together, a single battle becomes a layered, coordinated offensive of your own making.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 高度、掩体、击退、碰撞与场景物件都能成为武器，可制造连锁反应并改造攻防空间。
hooks.excerpt: Height, cover, displacement, knockbacks, collisions, and battlefield objects and terrain all have a real impact on combat. Slam enemies into obstacles, trigger chain reactions through objects, and use terrain to reshape both offense and defense.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 击败强敌获得“回响”来推进区域，再收集章节记忆碎片揭开角色过去与世界秘密。
hooks.excerpt: Defeat powerful enemies and obtain precious Echoes to advance the story and unlock deeper regions. But that is only the beginning. Keep venturing deeper and collect Chapter Memory Fragments to uncover each character’s hidden past—and the deeper secrets of the world itself.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
